description: Lengte van vaarwegen; vaarwegkenmerken, regio, 2005 t/m 2018 is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CBS OpenData. Deze tabel bevat informatie over de lengte van vaarwegen. Hierbij wordt onderscheid gemaakt naar de kenmerken beheerder, bevaarbaarheid, economisch belang, recreatietoervaartklasse en vaarwegkarakter. Gegevens beschikbaar vanaf: 2005. Status van de cijfers: Definitief. Wijziging per december 2023: Sinds 2019 heeft de Rijkswaterstaat de kenmerken: beheerder, bevaarbaarheid, economisch belang, recreatietoervaartklasse en vaarwegkarakter niet meer bijgewerkt. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher CBS OpenData. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ATOM, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON. The portal shows 2025-12-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
